notes.title: New update patch 0.23
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38602618/ea23d908b99b2723ef4c7b230866c00491a29615.png[/img] 
    - Added security screens (spot all players)
    - Added animation for grenade launcher
    - Added new supersprint (press sprint key twice)
    - Added new turret object. You can activate it with special keycard (found in mini replicators)
    - Added crosshair stabilization
    - Added new optimization technologies (reduce texture quality)
    - Added death time penalty for robots
    - Added quickscope for sniper rifle
    - Added level props
    - Reduce accumulator sizes
    - Fixed bunny hop
    - Fixed options
    - Fixed hangs in tray
    - Fixed some shops problems
    - Fixed drop items from dead player
    - Fixed reward screen
    - Fixed Left hand IK
